title: A part month's pay (PRD-002 NM-PAY-12, owner decision of 21 Nov 2026: MOM's working days)
description: Monthly basic × the working days the person is employed in the month ÷ the working days of the month, rounded once to the cent, half away from zero. Working days are the days of the working pattern: rest days and non-working days are left out and public holidays are counted (MOM, monthly-and-daily-salary). One case of the hand-worked list both implementations must reproduce.

basic.description: The monthly basic salary of the pay record, dollars

month.description: The first day of the wage month

working_weekdays.description: ISO weekdays the person works: 1 Monday to 7 Sunday

from.description: The first day of the span the pay covers: the later of the month's first day, the record's start and the person's start

to.description: The last day of the span: the earlier of the month's last day, the day before the record's end and the leaving day. Before `from` means no span
